facts.description: TUI note-taking app in Rust — Yazi-style navigation, notebooks as independent git repos, real per-note version history, themes, and fast fuzzy search.

research.name: shiki
research.note: Terminal note-taking app with a three-pane Miller-column browser, rendered Markdown preview, and git branch and commit controls per notebook.

effects: three-pane Miller-column notes browser (notebooks, notes, rendered Markdown preview) in the terminal
git state per notebook in the status bar (branch and pending change count) with an in-app commit prompt
built-in themes that recolor the whole TUI (Gruvbox Dark and Cyberpunk 2077 screenshots compared)
